Fast, reliable, efficient service available to clients in the comfort of their homes.

medicaidProviders: University of Maryland Medical System Health Plans
guidance: Patients should contact their insurance provider directly to verify mental health benefits and coverage before an appointment.
Restoration LLC bills insurance companies directly for services rendered.
Copayments, deductibles, or coinsurance are due at the time of service.
Administrative staff can help answer questions about insurance coverage and payment options.

appointments.summary: New and returning patients can request an appointment online. The team reviews appointment details and follows up with next steps.

safetyAndScope.notForEmergencies: For medical emergencies, call 911 immediately or go to the nearest emergency room.
chatbotBoundaries: The chatbot can answer general website questions about services, providers, insurance, appointments, location, contact details, and hours.
The chatbot must not diagnose, provide treatment plans, give medication advice, provide crisis counseling, or replace professional medical care.
For urgent medical concerns, users should call 911 or seek emergency care.
